title: Natural proper base change for native derived Weil modules
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the native coefficient sheaves $B_{\bar T}$, abelian Weil categories $\mathcal W_T$, their ordinary derived categories $D(\mathcal W_T)$, bounded constructible full subcategories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(T)$, and the actual equivariant operations of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}Z'&\xrightarrow{v}&Z\\ p'\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\ T'&\xrightarrow{u}&T\end{array}$$
be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of $k_0$-schemes and $k_0$-morphisms, with $p$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $T,T'$ quasi-compact, quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] and locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] over $k_0$. There is no absolute separatedness hypothesis on $T$ or $T'$, and $u$ is arbitrary. For the actual ordinary right-derived pushforwards $Rp_*,Rp'_*$ and the termwise inverse images $u^*,v^*$, there exists a natural isomorphism of functors
$$u^*Rp_*\ \cong\ Rp'_*v^*:\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Z)\longrightarrow D(\mathcal W_{T'}).$$
Every component, inverse and naturality equality is in the native equivariant derived category; no identification of $D(\mathcal W_T)$ with fixed pairs in a geometric derived category is assumed.

proof.text: Apply geometric proper base change to this forgotten complex. The forget-mate equality conjugates that invertible component by sourceComparison and targetComparison, so the image under derived forgetting of beta_K is invertible. The proved fixed-pair forget theorem makes derived forgetting conservative; hence beta_K itself is invertible.

The statement is unchanged. It has no new nodes and cites no SGA. The steps follow the blueprint route: (1) fixed-pair forgetting gives Grothendieck categories, preservation of K-injectives and a conservative D(U), with no separatedness; (2) fixed-pair-adjunction-lift, whose mate-formula conventions I checked; (3) the derived adjunction plus the kun derived-adjoint-square comparison, whose right-derived hypothesis holds via adapted K-injectives; (4) β is the unit–square–counit mate, matching sk-def-sfb-base-change-morphism; (5) affine charts A' ⊂ u^{-1}A, with Z_A separated via the separated-over-affine lemma and base change to k, so the dc-setting holds and no affine intersections are used; (6) qcqs stratification and the native/condensed constructibility comparison; (7) finite-span comparison, rational PBC (3) at Q̄_ℓ, open-descent for base opens and the slice comparison for target opens, checked on the K-injective representative; (8) sheaf axiom, the cohomology criterion and conservativity. Edge cases checked: u = id, empty schemes, K = 0, rank 0, and T the affine line with doubled origin. No duplicate in the DAG.
